name: str_date_parse_invoice_header
source_sql: SELECT invoice_id AS "invoice_id", TO_DATE(invoice_dt DEFAULT NULL ON CONVERSION ERROR, 'DD-MON-YY', 'NLS_DATE_LANGUAGE=ENGLISH') AS "invoice_dt_parsed", TO_DATE(due_dt DEFAULT NULL ON CONVERSION ERROR, 'DD-MON-YY', 'NLS_DATE_LANGUAGE=ENGLISH') AS "due_dt_parsed" FROM ow_billing.invoice_header ORDER BY invoice_id
target_sql: SELECT invoice_id, invoice_dt_parsed, due_dt_parsed FROM ow_tp.silver.invoice_header ORDER BY invoice_id
